hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$d=[Console]::In.ReadToEnd()|ConvertFrom-Json; $p=[string]$d.tool_input.file_path; if($p -match '\.(g|freezed)\.dart$'){[Console]::Error.WriteLine('Blocked: ' + $p + ' is generated.
